description: Plan Director del Servicio municipal de abastecimiento de agua del municipio de Berga is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ajberga.cat. The plans of the Master Plan of the Municipal water supply service of the municipality of Berga, are the planning instrument in this area that establishes how the city's future water supply infrastructure should be. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Master Plan of the Municipal water supply service of the municipality of Berga" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Water supply, Instalaciones de abastecimiento de agua, Waterworks, Berga, Abastament d'aigua, Water management. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
